_meta.description: Marine fuel properties for Well-to-Wake lifecycle analysis
sources: IMO MEPC.364(79) - 2022 Guidelines on the method of calculation of the attained EEDI
IMO MEPC.1/Circ.905 - LCA Guidelines for marine fuels (WtW default values)
IPCC AR6 GWP100 factors for CH4 (29.8) and N2O (273)
EU FuelEU Maritime Regulation (EU) 2023/1805 Annex II default WtT intensities

units.cf_tco2_per_tfuel: tCO2 per tonne fuel (IMO carbon factor, tank-to-wake CO2 only)
units.ef_ttw_gco2e_per_gfuel: gCO2e per g fuel, tank-to-wake incl. CH4 slip + N2O (GWP100)
units.ef_wtt_gco2e_per_mj: gCO2e per MJ fuel energy, well-to-tank (upstream)
units.engine_efficiency: Thermal efficiency of prime mover on this fuel (dimensionless)

fuels.name: Heavy Fuel Oil
fuels.notes: Baseline residual fuel. Not permitted in Emission Control Areas without scrubber.

fuels.name: Very Low Sulphur Fuel Oil
fuels.notes: IMO 2020 compliant residual blend. Current fleet default.

fuels.name: Marine Gas Oil
fuels.notes: Distillate fuel. ECA compliant, higher cost.

fuels.name: Liquefied Natural Gas
fuels.notes: TtW factor includes 3.1% methane slip at GWP100=29.8 for 4-stroke dual-fuel Otto engines. This is why LNG's real climate benefit is far below its CO2-only figure.

fuels.name: Methanol (natural gas derived)
fuels.notes: Low TtW CO2 per tonne but half the energy density of HFO, and heavy upstream burden from steam methane reforming.

fuels.name: e-Methanol (renewable)
fuels.notes: Negative WtT because the carbon in the fuel is captured from biogenic/DAC sources, offsetting combustion CO2 on a lifecycle basis.

fuels.name: Ammonia (fossil derived)
fuels.notes: Zero-carbon at the stack, but grey ammonia from Haber-Bosch on natural gas is worse WtW than HFO. TtW is N2O slip only.

fuels.name: Green Ammonia (renewable H2)
fuels.notes: Deep decarbonisation pathway. Requires N2O aftertreatment and toxicity handling.

fuels.name: Green Hydrogen (liquid)
fuels.notes: Zero TtW. WtT from renewable electrolysis plus liquefaction (~30% of energy content). Volumetric density is the binding constraint on range.
